_comment: Single source of truth for the game (CLAUDE.md rule 5 applied to the game), read by engine/game.py, tools/asset_generation/scenes.py and the app. docs/game_design.md v1.6; DECISIONS D-56, D-61, D-63, D-65, D-66, D-68, D-69, D-72, D-73, D-74, D-75.

points._comment: No points per logged entry (D-75: P1); logging earns 'verified' (the month adds up) and streak milestones. Saving = money set aside minus new borrowing; paying debt down to a new low earns the separate, larger debt points, if the payments were logged in a verified month (R5).

reward_tiers._comment: R6 (D-75): check-ins earn the least, logging second, good financial health the most; tests/test_game.py fails if the numbers break this order

epf._comment: Since May 2024 each EPF contribution is split 75% Akaun Persaraan / 15% Sejahtera / 10% Fleksibel; only Fleksibel counts as cushion money (C6)

unlock._comment: C1 (D-75): a room level or milestone unlocks when the month is verified, or when the cushion holds at the next check-in

verification._comment: Option 2 (D-75): a month is verified when something was logged, the logged money in covers the month's income, and the change in the user's money matches logged money in - out; tolerance max(RM, share of income)

game_cushion._comment: counted money / max(3-month average of logged essentials + debt payments, declared typical costs (or a share of income if none), the plausibility floor unless the user's costs are trusted) (game_design §7a, D-75)

plausible_cost_floor._comment: Option 1 (D-75): P10 of monthly essentials + debt payments by user type and living arrangement in the DOSM-calibrated synthetic population (data/synthetic/medium_seed20261009)

goals._comment: P2 (D-75): a personal monthly goal for the garden; progress = money set aside + debt paid down (C2)

growth._comment: growing day = a day whose latest monthly result is not 'really bad' (C5, D-75; was 'not Red', D-74)

really_bad._comment: RED and (shortfall or forecast probability >= ratio x base rate) (D-73); after rest_after_months in a row, plants rest calmly and the app suggests AKPK (I3, D-75)
